name: Toudou Akito
source:
A good-looking but average young man. A virgin. A student. 
His sexual tastes are also average... at least he thought so, until he meets Ryoko. Raised on frequent overseas vacations he has a worldly sensibility. Lately at school he's felt a good vibe with Yui, a girl in his class, but his inability to read the signs at this early stage are kind of frustrating. Their burgeoning relationship is nice enough. Akito enjoys school. One afternoon he succeeds in going the next step with Yui by walking her home to her house... and that's when Ryoko appears. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE150436.html]DLsite English[/url]]
